Entries.SeedShop_Tue: $query TIME 1300 1600#There you are! We just finished the harder part of the exercise class. Caroline says I should stop complaining about the music, but I think she enjoys making us suffer.$h#$b#Still, I look forward to Tuesdays. It's nice to have a reason to leave the house that isn't buying groceries or running errands.$q 794801004/794801005/794801006 jodi_exercise_followup#Would you like to ask me about the ladies' exercise group?$r 794801004 0 jodi_exercise_caroline#How did you and Caroline become such close friends?$r 794801005 0 jodi_exercise_group#What's everyone like during the classes?$r 794801006 0 jodi_exercise_youth#Did you always enjoy exercising?|Caroline is probably still counting repetitions. I can hear her from here.$h#$b#I'll catch up with her in a moment.
Entries.SeedShop_Sun: $query TIME 1100 1600#The chapel is quiet at this hour. I used to come here quite often when Kent was overseas.$s#$b#Some days I prayed for his safety. Other days I just needed somewhere to sit where nobody expected me to be cheerful.$q 794801007/794801008/794801009 jodi_chapel_followup#Can I ask you about those years?$r 794801007 0 jodi_chapel_letters#What was it like waiting for Kent's letters?$r 794801008 0 jodi_chapel_anger#Were you ever angry about being left to manage everything?$r 794801009 0 jodi_chapel_quiet#Would you rather I just sat with you?|I like stopping here before heading home. It gives me a little time to collect my thoughts.$s
Entries.Hospital: $query TIME 1130 1600#Vincent always says he isn't nervous before a check-up. Then he holds my hand so tightly I can barely feel my fingers.$h#$b#I suppose he gets that from me. I still get nervous whenever one of my boys needs a doctor.$s#$q 794801010/794801011/794801012 jodi_clinic_followup#Do you mind if I ask about being a mother?$r 794801010 0 jodi_clinic_vincent#Were you always this worried about Sam and Vincent?$r 794801011 0 jodi_clinic_young#Did having children so young change your plans?$r 794801012 0 jodi_clinic_self#Do you remember to look after yourself, too?|Harvey says I'm doing fine. I wish I could convince myself as easily as he convinces his patients.$h
Entries.JojaMart_Wed: $query TIME 1250 1700#I know Joja isn't everyone's favorite place, but when Kent was away I learned to compare every price. A few coins saved here and there mattered when I was buying for the whole family.$s#$b#I used to feel guilty if I spent anything on myself.$q 794801013/794801014/794801015 jodi_joja_followup#Would you like to ask me about keeping the household going?$r 794801013 0 jodi_joja_budget#Was it difficult managing the money while Kent was away?$r 794801014 0 jodi_joja_self#Did you ever buy something just for yourself?$r 794801015 0 jodi_joja_future#Did you imagine a different life back then?|I'm only here for a few things today. I made a list, and I'm determined not to come home with twice as much.$h
Entries.JojaMart_Fri: $query TIME 1250 1700#I used to know exactly how much everything cost. I could plan a week's meals just by looking at the prices.$s#$b#It was useful, but I don't miss having to think about every single coin quite so carefully.$q 794801013/794801014/794801015 jodi_joja_followup#Would you like to ask me about keeping the household going?$r 794801013 0 jodi_joja_budget#Was it difficult managing the money while Kent was away?$r 794801014 0 jodi_joja_self#Did you ever buy something just for yourself?$r 794801015 0 jodi_joja_future#Did you imagine a different life back then?|I should get these groceries home before I forget what I came for.$h
Entries.SamHouse: $query TIME 2100 2200#The boys are finally settled for the night. It's strange how quiet the house becomes after all that noise.$s#$b#I used to complain about the mess they made. Now I sometimes miss finding their toys under the sofa.$h#$q 794801016/794801017/794801018 jodi_house_followup#Can I ask you something about raising Sam and Vincent?$r 794801016 0 jodi_house_chores#Why did you let the boys grow up without many chores?$r 794801017 0 jodi_house_protect#Were you afraid they were growing up too quickly?$r 794801018 0 jodi_house_balance#Did you ever wish someone would take care of you for a change?|I should check that Vincent is comfortable before I turn in. Goodnight, @.$h

Entries.AcceptBirthdayGift: Oh, @... you remembered my birthday. Thank you.$h#$b#I used to spend birthdays making sure everyone else had a nice day. I think I'm finally learning that I can make a wish for myself, too.$l#$q 794801001/794801002/794801003 jodi_birthday_followup#Would you like to ask me about what I wanted when I was younger?$r 794801001 0 jodi_birthday_dream#What did you dream of doing before you had a family?$r 794801002 0 jodi_birthday_regret#Do you ever regret marrying so young?$r 794801003 0 jodi_birthday_wish#I hope you get to do something just for yourself this year.
Entries.AcceptGift_(O)136: A largemouth bass!$h#$b#That takes me back to the evening I asked you to bring one for dinner. I was so nervous about the meal that I nearly forgot to enjoy having company.$l#$q 794801022/794801023/794801024 jodi_bass_followup#Would you like to ask me about that first dinner?$r 794801022 0 jodi_bass_dinner#Were you nervous because you wanted me to like you?$r 794801023 0 jodi_bass_kent#Was Kent already home by then?$r 794801024 0 jodi_bass_cooking#What did you make with the fish after that?
Entries.AcceptGift_(O)211: Pancakes! You know, Sam used to ask for these almost every morning. He'd sit at the table with his hair sticking up in every direction.$h#$q 794801025/794801026/794801027 jodi_pancake_followup#Would you like to hear what Sam was like as a little boy?$r 794801025 0 jodi_pancake_sam#Was he always so energetic?$r 794801026 0 jodi_pancake_vincent#Was Vincent different from him?$r 794801027 0 jodi_pancake_parent#Did you enjoy being a young mother?
Entries.AcceptGift_(O)222: Rhubarb pie... That smell reminds me of Granny's old cottage. I haven't thought about it in a while.$h#$q 794801028/794801029/794801030 jodi_pie_followup#Would you like to ask me about my grandmother's cottage?$r 794801028 0 jodi_pie_granny#What was the cottage like?$r 794801029 0 jodi_pie_childhood#What do you remember most about being a child?$r 794801030 0 jodi_pie_recipe#Did your grandmother teach you to cook?
Entries.AcceptGift_(O)214: Crispy Bass! The breading is just right. I always liked recipes that could turn simple ingredients into something special.$h#$q 794801031/794801032/794801033 jodi_crispy_followup#Would you like to ask me about cooking for the family?$r 794801031 0 jodi_crispy_kent#What did Kent like to eat?$r 794801032 0 jodi_crispy_boys#Were Sam and Vincent picky eaters?$r 794801033 0 jodi_crispy_cooking#Did you always enjoy cooking?
Entries.AcceptGift_(O)220: Chocolate cake! That's a lovely surprise.$h#$b#It reminds me of birthdays when I was little, when a treat like this made the whole day feel special.$l
Entries.AcceptGift_(O)231: Eggplant Parmesan! I used to make dishes like this when I wanted the boys to eat something hearty without noticing how many vegetables were in it.$h
Entries.AcceptGift_(O)225: Fried Eel... Kent used to enjoy a meal with a little more spice. I wonder if he still does.$s
Entries.AcceptGift_(O)200: Vegetable Medley! This is the sort of meal I always hoped the boys would eat without negotiating every bite.$h#$b#Some battles are never truly won.

Changes.LogName: Jodi: player question responses and follow-up topics

Entries.jodi_birthday_followup: I've already told you a little about my younger days, haven't I?$s#$b#It's nice to remember them without feeling as if I have to go back and change everything.$l
Entries.jodi_birthday_dream: $t JodiBirthdayMemory 7#I wanted to see more of the world, and I wanted to find out what I enjoyed when I wasn't looking after somebody else. I don't think those wishes were selfish. I just put them away for a long time.$s
Entries.jodi_birthday_regret: $t JodiBirthdayMemory 7#I don't regret my family. I do sometimes wish I'd had more time to understand myself before I became a wife and mother.$s#$b#Both things can be true, I think.
Entries.jodi_birthday_wish: $t JodiBirthdayMemory 7#Then that's what I'll try to do. Maybe I'll take a day trip, buy a book, or simply leave the dishes until tomorrow.$h#$b#That last one might be the most difficult.
Entries.JodiBirthdayMemory: I've been thinking about what you said. I spent so long measuring a good day by how much I got done. I'd like to measure a few of them by how happy I felt instead.$l
Entries.jodi_exercise_followup: We were talking about the exercise group, weren't we? I should introduce you to everyone properly sometime.$h
Entries.jodi_exercise_caroline: $t JodiExerciseMemory 7#Caroline and I have known each other for years. She's one of the few people I can tell absolutely anything to. She never makes me feel silly for wanting more out of life.$l#$b#Sometimes she understands what I'm trying to say before I do.
Entries.jodi_exercise_group: $t JodiExerciseMemory 7#Marnie is determined, Robin is stronger than she looks, Emily makes everything sound cheerful, and Caroline... well, Caroline likes to win.$h#$b#I mostly try to keep up and not laugh when somebody loses count.
Entries.jodi_exercise_youth: $t JodiExerciseMemory 7#Not always. I used to think exercise was just another chore. Now I like having an hour that belongs to me, even if my knees complain about it afterward.$h
Entries.JodiExerciseMemory: I used to think friendship meant having someone to share errands with. Caroline taught me it's also having someone who reminds you that you're allowed to want things for yourself.$l
Entries.jodi_chapel_followup: I don't mind talking about those years anymore. I just need to take them one memory at a time.$s
Entries.jodi_chapel_letters: $t JodiKentLetters 7#At first I counted the days until the next letter. Then I counted the weeks. I tried to keep the boys' routine steady so they wouldn't notice how worried I was.$s#$b#I always read his letters twice. Once for the words, and once just to feel that he was still out there.
Entries.jodi_chapel_anger: $t JodiKentLetters 7#Sometimes, yes. I felt angry that I had to be brave every day while he was somewhere I couldn't reach. Then I'd feel guilty for being angry, because I knew he hadn't chosen an easy life either.$s
Entries.jodi_chapel_quiet: $t JodiKentLetters 7#I'd like that. You don't have to fill every silence, @. Sometimes having somebody nearby is enough.$l
Entries.JodiKentLetters: When Kent came home, I wanted everything to feel familiar again. It didn't. I had to learn the person standing in front of me, and he had to learn us all over again.$s#$b#I wish I'd understood sooner that neither of us could simply return to the way things were.
Entries.jodi_clinic_followup: I suppose I talk about the boys more easily than I talk about myself. Old habit.$h
Entries.jodi_clinic_vincent: $t JodiClinicMemory 7#Sam was always adventurous, but Vincent was the one who would come running to me with every little worry. I try not to make him feel that worrying is something he has to hide.$s
Entries.jodi_clinic_young: $t JodiClinicMemory 7#I was young when Sam was born. I loved him immediately, but I was still learning everything myself. There were days when I felt as if both of us were growing up at once.$s
Entries.jodi_clinic_self: $t JodiClinicMemory 7#I try. I really do. But when everyone needs something, my own aches seem easy to put off. Harvey keeps reminding me that ignoring them doesn't make me stronger.$h
Entries.JodiClinicMemory: I want the boys to remember a mother who laughed with them, not only one who hurried from one chore to the next. I'm trying to make more room for that now.$l
Entries.jodi_joja_followup: I don't miss worrying over every receipt. I do remember how carefully I had to plan, though.$s
Entries.jodi_joja_budget: $t JodiJojaMemory 7#It was tiring. I learned which meals could stretch for another day and which things we could postpone. I never wanted the boys to feel that we were struggling.$s
Entries.jodi_joja_self: $t JodiJojaMemory 7#Sometimes I did, but I'd stand in the shop holding something and think of three other things the money should go toward. It took me a long time to stop doing that.$s
Entries.jodi_joja_future: $t JodiJojaMemory 7#I imagined taking a trip, having an afternoon with no responsibilities, perhaps learning something just because I was curious. Small things, really. But they felt impossibly far away back then.$s
Entries.JodiJojaMemory: I don't think there's anything wrong with being careful about money. I just don't want fear to make every decision for me anymore.$l
Entries.jodi_house_followup: I still think about those years. I love the boys dearly, but I know I made some choices because I was afraid of seeing them unhappy.$s
Entries.jodi_house_chores: $t JodiQuietHouse 7#I wanted them to have a childhood without feeling that every minute had to be useful. Perhaps I went too far in the other direction.$h#$b#I could have asked them to help sometimes. The house wouldn't have collapsed.
Entries.jodi_house_protect: $t JodiQuietHouse 7#Yes. I blinked and Sam was taller than me. Then Vincent started asking questions I couldn't answer with a bedtime story. I wanted to protect their childhood for as long as I could.$s
Entries.jodi_house_balance: $t JodiQuietHouse 7#I did. I wasn't always good at asking for help, especially when Kent was away. I thought being a good mother meant never getting tired.$s#$b#I'm trying to teach myself otherwise.
Entries.JodiQuietHouse: The house is quieter now, but I don't want to fill every quiet moment with work. I want to enjoy the people who are still here, and remember the ones who are growing up.$l
Entries.jodi_greenrain_followup: I know I can be overprotective. I just remember what it felt like to be the only adult in the house when Kent was away.$s
Entries.jodi_greenrain_kent: $t JodiGreenRainMemory 7#It was. Every strange sound made me wonder whether the boys were frightened. I tried to be calm for them, even when I wanted someone to tell me everything would be all right.$s
Entries.jodi_greenrain_boys: $t JodiGreenRainMemory 7#Sam liked to act brave, and Vincent asked a hundred questions. They were different in almost every way, but both wanted me nearby when something felt unfamiliar.$h
Entries.jodi_greenrain_help: $t JodiGreenRainMemory 7#Would you? Maybe you could help me find something indoors to keep Vincent busy. Sam will claim he's too old, but he'll join in eventually.$h
Entries.JodiGreenRainMemory: I don't think the boys needed a perfect mother. They needed someone who stayed close when they were scared. I hope I managed that.$s
Entries.jodi_bass_followup: That first dinner was a little nerve-racking, wasn't it? I was glad you came.$l
Entries.jodi_bass_dinner: $t JodiFirstDinner 7#I was. I wanted you to have a good evening with the family, and I worried about every little thing. I even checked the casserole twice before it was ready.$h
Entries.jodi_bass_kent: $t JodiFirstDinner 7#$d kent#Kent was home by then. There were parts of our life together that were still good, even when things were difficult. I don't want to pretend every memory was unhappy.$s|Kent was still overseas. I wanted to make a good evening for you and the boys, and I remember being nervous about getting every little thing right.$s
Entries.jodi_bass_cooking: $t JodiFirstDinner 7#I used the fish for the casserole. I remember being so busy making sure everyone had enough that I barely sat down myself.$h#$b#Some habits take a while to change.
Entries.JodiFirstDinner: I remember that evening more fondly now. It was one of the first times I let someone new into our family routine, and you made it feel easy.$l
Entries.jodi_pancake_followup: Sam and Vincent were very different little boys. I learned quickly that one recipe never pleased both of them.$h
Entries.jodi_pancake_sam: $t JodiSamChildhood 7#He was always full of energy. Even breakfast could turn into an adventure with him. He'd tell me a story while I was trying to keep the pancakes from burning.$h
Entries.jodi_pancake_vincent: $t JodiSamChildhood 7#Vincent was a little more cautious. He liked knowing what was going to happen next, unless Sam was around. Then he'd follow his brother into almost anything.$h
Entries.jodi_pancake_parent: $t JodiSamChildhood 7#I did. I was frightened sometimes, because I was young and didn't know whether I was doing things right. But I loved being their mother. I still do.$l
Entries.JodiSamChildhood: I don't want to forget how small their hands used to be, or how they sounded when they laughed together. That's why I keep old photographs.$s#$b#One day they'll probably tease me for it.$h
Entries.jodi_pie_followup: I haven't thought about Granny's cottage in a long time. Funny how a smell can bring a whole place back.$s
Entries.jodi_pie_granny: $t JodiGrannyCottage 7#It was a cozy place. I remember the smell of the kitchen and how everything seemed to slow down there. I didn't know then how precious an ordinary afternoon could be.$s
Entries.jodi_pie_childhood: $t JodiGrannyCottage 7#I remember little things more than big events. Warm food, a quiet room, and feeling that there was nowhere else I needed to be.$s#$b#I suppose that's why I still love cooking for people.
Entries.jodi_pie_recipe: $t JodiGrannyCottage 7#I learned by watching and helping. I don't remember every measurement, but I remember the smells and the feeling of being welcome in that kitchen.$l
Entries.JodiGrannyCottage: I wish I could visit that old cottage again. Not because I want to live in the past, but because I'd like to thank the people who made those memories feel safe.$s
Entries.jodi_crispy_followup: Cooking was one of the ways I showed people I cared. I'm learning that I can show it in other ways, too.$h
Entries.jodi_crispy_kent: $t JodiFamilyMeals 7#Kent liked hearty meals. I used to try to have something ready when he came home. I think I was hoping that a familiar dinner would make everything feel normal again.$s
Entries.jodi_crispy_boys: $t JodiFamilyMeals 7#Sam would eat quickly and ask to leave the table, while Vincent could spend ages deciding whether he liked something. I learned to be patient.$h
Entries.jodi_crispy_cooking: $t JodiFamilyMeals 7#I did, but for a long time it felt like another responsibility. I'm trying to enjoy it again now, especially when I can cook something because I want to.$l
Entries.JodiFamilyMeals: I want cooking to feel like sharing something, not another chore I have to finish before bedtime. It's a small change, but it makes the kitchen feel different.$l
